sentences.en: It seems this country doesn't really uphold the idea of freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 看来这个国家并不真正支持言论自由的理念。

sentences.en: As a public official you have sworn an oath to uphold and defend the constitution.
sentences.zh: 作为一名公职人员，你已经宣誓要维护并捍卫宪法。
我们必须维持家庭传统。

senses.zh: 支持，维护；举起，抬起；维持，确认（判决等）
